questions.why: the retained study estimates an average effect (ATE of treatment on outcome, constant across units) and was not fitted with an effect modifier, so a conditional effect under 'baseline == 1' cannot be read from it, and it is not derived by subsetting the population and refitting during inference; answering this needs a study fitted explicitly with that modifier declared and a heterogeneous-effect estimand -- this provider serves one when it is retained (`python -m causal_inference_provider prepare-demo --with-modifier` fits the synthetic development one), and it is named as its own study, not read out of this one.
